description: Index and query signed, expiring identity address, public-share availability, and published trust records.

operation.description: Operation: index, resolveIdentity, locateShare, findTrust, listIdentities, or listTrust.

records.description: Canonical encoded discovery records submitted for paid retention.

identityId.description: Exact 32-byte identity ID selected by resolveIdentity.

shareId.description: Exact 32-byte Public File Sharing share ID selected by locateShare.

subjectId.description: Exact 32-byte subject identity selected by findTrust.

recordLimit.description: Maximum signed records requested from an exact lookup.

indexerLimit.description: Maximum candidate indexers requested from an exact lookup.

afterEvaluatorId.description: Exclusive evaluator part of a listTrust cursor.

afterSubjectId.description: Exclusive subject part of a listTrust cursor.

afterRecordId.description: Exclusive record-ID part of a listTrust cursor.

limit.description: Maximum entries requested from a list operation.

acceptedAt.description: Provider acceptance time for an index operation.

recordId.description: SHA-256 ID of the accepted discovery-record signing bytes.

storedUntil.description: End of the provider's paid record-retention commitment.

subjectId.description: Exact trust subject selected by findTrust.

shareRecords.description: Current canonical encoded share records, including tied negative records needed to expose equivocation.

indexers.description: Candidate indexers ordered by XOR distance from the lookup key.

addressRecord.description: Current canonical address record signed by the candidate identity.

identities.description: Known 32-byte identity IDs in unsigned lexicographic order.

more.description: Whether another listing entry existed when the page was produced.

price.description: Credits charged for the successful operation.

check.description: Locally validate lookup or listing output, or retrieve the exact record bytes for one accepted index placement before its storage end time.

indexId.description: Provider-generated 32-byte index placement ID for a retention check.

recordId.description: Expected 32-byte discovery record ID for a retention check.

identityId.description: Requested identity for a resolveIdentity check.

shareId.description: Requested share for a locateShare check.

subjectId.description: Requested trust subject for a findTrust check.

afterIdentityId.description: Original listIdentities cursor when one was supplied.

afterEvaluatorId.description: Original evaluator part of a listTrust cursor.

afterSubjectId.description: Original subject part of a listTrust cursor.

afterRecordId.description: Original record-ID part of a listTrust cursor.

addressRecords.description: Complete address-record array returned by resolveIdentity.

shareRecords.description: Complete share-record array returned by locateShare.

trustRecords.description: Complete trust-record array returned by findTrust or listTrust.

indexers.description: Complete candidate-indexer array returned by an exact lookup.

addressRecord.description: Current canonical address record signed by the candidate identity.

identities.description: Complete identity-ID page returned by listIdentities.

outcome.description: Requester-computed verification result: pass, fail, or inconclusive.

record.description: Exact retained discovery-record bytes returned for an index-placement check.
